title: Add optional tagged cross-session request and reply notifications
outcome: Add an optional request/reply workflow on top of asynchronous messaging. A sender can issue a tagged request, a receiver can reply against that tag, and TermAl notifies or resumes the sender when the tagged reply lands, similar to task completion notifications.
acceptance: Tagged requests and replies retain thread identity across queueing and restart. A matching reply produces one sender notification with the responder and message reference; unmatched ordinary messages remain unchanged. Timeouts, duplicate replies, multiple responders, cancellation, and cross-repository permissions have defined behavior and tests.
